definitions.explanation: Made at home or in-house, rather than purchased from a store or manufacturer. Commonly used for food, drinks, and crafts. In restaurant contexts, it means made on the premises.

examples.japanese: {自家製|じかせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}いた→焼く：01123_yaku⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自家製|じかせい}⟦パスタ→パスタ：06768_pasuta⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{自慢|じまん}→自慢：03278_jiman⟧だ。
examples.english: This restaurant takes pride in its house-made pasta.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧{自家製|じかせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{梅干|うめぼ}し→梅干し：13110_umeboshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{漬|つ}けて→漬ける：09861_tsukeru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother makes homemade pickled plums for us every year.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a noun modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {自家製|じかせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun. Very common on restaurant menus and product labels. Conveys a sense of quality and care compared to mass-produced alternatives.

Compared to ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧ (handmade), {自家製|じかせい} emphasizes that something was made in-house or at home (the location), while ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧ emphasizes that it was crafted by hand (the method).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自家製|じかせい}⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧: homemade bread
- {自家製|じかせい}⟦ソース→ソース：17673_soosu⟧: house-made sauce
- {自家製|じかせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧: homemade miso
- {自家製|じかせい}{麺|めん}: house-made noodles
